articles.title: Final land distribution, allotment decisions cannot be reopened, rules FCC
articles.summary: ISLAMABAD - Federal Constitutional Court (FCCP) has ruled that final decisions by revenue and consolidation authorities regarding land distribution and allotment cannot be reopened merely on the basis of disputes over land identification or khasra numbers.

articles.title: IHC CJ refers plea challenging Judicial Commission decision to another bench
articles.summary: ISLAMABAD - Chief Justice, Islamabad High Court (IHC) Sardar Muhammad Sarfraz Dogar on Friday directed the constitution of a new bench to hear a constitutional petition challenging the April 28, decision of the Judicial Commission of Pakistan.

articles.title: NA unanimously passes resolution against all forms of workplace harassment
articles.summary: ISLAMABAD - National Assembly on Friday unanimously passed a resolution reaffirming Parliament’s commitment to protecting the dignity, equality and rights of every individual against all forms of workplace harassment and gender-based discrimination.

articles.summary: If the accusations are true, the record-making heist shows how powerful suspected North Korean hackers have become.

articles.summary: Shares in Intel continue to fall while the tech-heavy Nasdaq opens at its lowest level in more than two months.

articles.title: Google value plunges by $500bn as its own AI search hits ad sales
articles.summary: Google spooked investors so badly that its stock hit a six-month low, after it revealed its AI own search summaries were affecting ad revenue.

articles.title: PM Shehbaz calls for stronger trade, investment ties with Singapore
articles.summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Friday reaffirmed Pakistan's commitment to strengthening its longstanding friendly relations with Singapore, as the two countries mark the 60th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties this year.

articles.title: How video game remakes tap the power of nostalgia
articles.summary: Video games are good at triggering nostalgia, a key reason why classic games keep getting remade.

articles.title: Riyadh under ‘hostile aerial threat’ as explosions heard
articles.summary: RIYADH/TEHRAN/WASHINGTON - Saudi air defenses intercepted and destroyed two ballistic missiles launched towards Riyadh by Yemen’s Houthi movement, the Saudi-led coalition said on Thursday, as authorities warned the capital was under a “hostile aerial threat” and AFP correspondents reported hearing at least eight explosions.

articles.summary: The English actor began his career on stage before finding fame as the captain of the USS Enterprise.

articles.title: CM Maryam announces additional Rs5b for stroke treatment
articles.summary: LAHORE - Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif on Thursday announced an additional Rs5 billion for stroke treatment and pledged to establish specialised stroke, cardiac, paediatric and cancer treatment facilities across the province to ensure access to advanced healthcare closer to patients’ homes.

articles.title: Almonds, cashews don’t fall within categories of smuggled goods, rules SC
articles.summary: ISLAMABAD - The Supreme Court has ruled that shelled almonds and cashews do not fall within the specific categories of smuggled goods listed under the Customs Act, observing that a violation of import restrictions alone does not automatically render goods legally smuggled.

articles.title: Pakistan crushes ISKP expansion, kills 50 terrorists
articles.summary: ISLAMABAD - Over the last three to four years, Pakistani security forces have effectively contained the expansionist ambitions of Islamic State Khorasan Province (ISKP), preventing the terror group from establishing a permanent operational footprint inside the country.

articles.title: CM Maryam announces Kisan Bank, Rs17bn subsidised loans for farmers
articles.summary: LAHORE - Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif on Wednesday announced the establishment of the province’s first ‘Apna Kisan Bank’, subsidised agricultural loans worth Rs17 billion and an increase in financing under the Kisan Card scheme as part of a series of measures aimed at supporting farmers and modernising the.

articles.title: US weighs fresh strikes on Iran as Qatar pushes peace deal
articles.summary: TEHRAN - The United States is preparing for a possible new round of military strikes against Iran after the November 3 midterm elections, with Washington reportedly telling several Gulf Arab countries to prepare for a “short, intense military campaign”, according to a report published by The Wall Street Journal and cited by.

articles.title: Justice Mohsin Akhtar Kayani resigns as LHC judge
articles.summary: LAHORE - Lahore High Court (LHC) Justice Mohsin Akhtar Kayani tendered his resignation on Wednesday, citing personal reasons, including health concerns, and what he described as growing executive interference in judicial affairs following the 26th and 27th Constitutional Amendments.

articles.title: FCC ‘concerned’ over course adopted by SC bench over already decided matter
articles.summary: ISLAMABAD - The Federal Constitutional Court (FCC) Wednesday reiterated that the jurisdiction of review, by its very nature, is limited and exceptional as its object is to correct an error apparent on the face of the record.

articles.title: AI, digitalisation central to national development: PM
articles.summary: ISLAMABAD - Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Wednesday directed relevant ministries to complete, by November, all necessary measures for projects being undertaken with Alibaba Group to advance artificial intelligence, digitalisation, exports and public service delivery.

articles.title: Exit polls set to be aired as voting draws to a close in Israel
articles.summary: JERUSALEM - Election day was near its money time as Israel’s television stations were set to air a set of exit polls right as voting ends at 10 pm on Tuesday, providing an estimate of the results.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia backs Pakistan mediation efforts to defuse regional tensions
articles.summary: RIYADH - The Saudi Council of Ministers on Tuesday reiterated Saudi Arabia’s firm commitment to advancing regional de-escalation, underscoring its strong support for all initiatives aimed at easing tensions, particularly the mediation efforts spearheaded by Qatar and Pakistan.

articles.title: Current fuel crisis linked to global price surge, says PM
articles.summary: ISLAMABAD - A delegation of Jamaat-e-Islami led by its Ameer Hafiz Naeem-ur-Rehman called on Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif in Islamabad on Tuesday.

articles.title: Pakistan rejects Afghan Taliban’s allegations, reaffirms right to self-defence
articles.summary: ISLAMABAD - Pakistan has categorically rejected the baseless and unsubstantiated allegations by the Afghan Taliban regime regarding civilian casualties attributed to its counter-terrorism operations.

articles.title: SBP raises policy rate by 50 bps to 12pc
articles.summary: KARACHI - The State Bank of Pakistan (SBP), on Monday, increased the policy rate by 50 bps to 12 percent owing to the continued geo-political uncertainties in the Middle East and rising energy costs and their potential impacts on domestic economy, inflation outlook and external account.

articles.title: 450 Palestinian families displaced in Hebron as Israeli military siege hits day 4
articles.summary: GAZA/UNITED NATIONS - Israeli forces forcibly displaced more than 450 families in the Hebron governorate, occupied West Bank, as a military siege entered its fourth consecutive day, according to the Palestinian News and Info Agency (WAFA).
